title: Journey to the West: Starting as the Son-in-Law of Gao Village
premise: A modern programmer transmigrates into Zhu Bajie · immediately recruited as a son-in-law by Old Gao · and must pretend not to know martial arts before the beautiful Cuilan
core_plothook: Uses modern business knowledge to transform Gao Village · becomes the local tycoon · but must dodge Wukong’s recruitment
selling_point: Comedy + slice-of-life farming + business warfare in one
target_audience: Urban-fiction fans · readers who want something light
key_quote: Me, Marshal Tianpeng, the former Supreme Commander of the Navy — now a son-in-law?

title: Fetch scriptures? I quit — Monkey wants to lie flat
premise: Banished back to Flower-Fruit Mountain by Tang Sanzang · this time Wukong truly quits · and starts a K-12 education system for his monkey descendants
core_plothook: Chaos breaks out across the three realms · the gods beg him to return · but Wukong says 'I’m retired — leave me alone'
popularity_estimate: High (9/10) · resonates with the current mood
key_quote: Go back just because you say so? I just bought a school-district house on Flower-Fruit Mountain

title: Great Tang Pilgrim: The Emperor Can Hear My Inner Voice
premise: Li Shimin can hear Tang Sanzang’s inner voice · discovering that this sworn brother grumbles daily about the long road and many demons
core_plothook: Li Shimin secretly arranges rescues along the way · throwing Guanyin’s script into chaos · and rewriting the pilgrimage project
target_audience: Power-fantasy readers · fans of meta jokes
key_quote: [Inner voice] Where the heck is this place? Why are there more demons than people?

title: Journey to the West: I Have a Tribulation System
setting: Flowing Sands River → the pilgrimage road
premise: Sha Wujing awakens a tribulation system · leveling up with each ordeal · and climbs from the quietest disciple to the strongest
core_plothook: System quest rewards let Sha Wujing grow stronger in silence · ultimately surpassing Wukong
key_quote: Ding! Host completed the 'Carry the Luggage 10,000 km' achievement · Reward: Constitution +10

title: Reborn as Tang Sanzang’s Elder Brother
premise: Revived, Chen Guangrui is reborn to before the pilgrimage begins · and resolves to protect his younger brother Tang Sanzang first
core_plothook: With memories of his past life · he remaps the pilgrimage route · turning 81 ordeals into 30
target_audience: Rebirth-fiction fans · readers who enjoy family bonds
key_quote: Xuanzang, big brother will never let you die at a demon’s hands this time

title: Journey to the West: I, the Six-Eared Macaque, Should Have Become a Buddha
premise: Retells the true-and-false Monkey King from the Six-Eared Macaque’s view · revealing he was Wukong’s other half · killed with one strike by Tathāgata
core_plothook: Reborn to before the true-and-false Monkey King incident · this time he’ll be himself, not a stand-in
selling_point: Villain’s point of view + anti-hero + philosophical
target_audience: Deep readers · fans of the villain’s perspective
key_quote: Why does he become a Buddha while I get killed? I’m the real Sun Wukong

title: Journey to the West: Return of Tianpeng
premise: Marshal Tianpeng is reborn · this time not flirting with Chang’e · but winning back every goddess through real action
core_plothook: Wins over Chang’e, Gao Cuilan, the Jade Rabbit Spirit, and the Spider Spirit · building the ultimate harem
key_quote: Everything I missed in my past life — I’ll have it all in this one

title: Journey to the West: I, Tathāgata, Invincible from the Start
premise: Tells the behind-the-scenes design of the 81 ordeals from Tathāgata’s view · every ordeal arranged by his own hand
core_plothook: Readers watch the show alongside Tathāgata · enjoying how his own script unfolds
selling_point: God’s-eye view + invincible power fantasy + behind-the-scenes
target_audience: Sophisticated readers · who enjoy watching the protagonist control everything
key_quote: Wukong, this ordeal is a growth lesson I designed for you

title: Journey to the West Instance: Farming Monsters on Spirit Mountain
premise: The protagonist is pulled into a Journey to the West instance world · and must clear all 81 ordeal instances to return to reality
core_plothook: Each instance has special rules · the protagonist must crack them to clear it
selling_point: Infinite flow + puzzle-solving + Journey to the West theme
key_quote: Instance · Flaming Mountain · S-rank difficulty · 5% survival rate
